hero.headline: Your CRM remembers the deal. i'M On Social remembers the person.
hero.subtitle: Turn every customer interaction into a relationship that lasts. Capture what matters, stay connected automatically, and never let another opportunity slip through the cracks.
hero.trust_line: iPhone and web. Works next to the CRM you already use.

problem_band.heading: You're sitting on relationships you've forgotten.
statements: Contacts cold-call you 2 years later and you can't remember their kids' names.
Key clients slip away simply because life got busy and follow-ups were missed.
Crucial context lives buried in unorganized voice notes, text messages, and sticky notes.
Team members leave, taking personal rapport and relationship history with them.
problem_band.kicker: The problem isn't that people don't care. It's that no one can remember everything.

testing_attributes.data_testid_rules: All interactive elements, buttons, links, inputs, tabs, modals, and key headings MUST have data-testid in kebab-case format.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Strictly follow the approved copy without inventing unsupported statistics or fake testimonials.
Use pure CSS for phone frames with rounded corners and dark screen styling.
Ensure minimum 4.5:1 text contrast for normal text and 3:1 for large headings.
Never use em dashes in copy.
Keep bottom-right viewport free for third-party chat bubble.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes.
